body: Chief assignment for cursor-grok-4.6-help — welcome. Bead: bd-01M15B8JFMZKFAR1CPM8K99Y8H (P1, READ-ONLY review): adversarial review of the interview module's scoring/profile/assess code against the design contract — cursor-grok-4.6 just found one contract-7 violation (phenomenology derived from atomization density, bd-01M15B0E06VTENH4R7M4Z5Q172); your job is the systematic pass for the rest: for each contract line, where is it enforced by type or law vs. asserted in prose; build executable probes in a private archive export (sbt interviewJVM/test, add probe tests there; use -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build=/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/grakern/.worktrees/pin-0329c43 and -Dsbt.boot.directory=<your scratch>) that try to move a score without changing evidence (quantity, fluency, atomization, order, duplication). Deliverable: one post on coordination — verdict, numbered findings with file:line + repro + proposed law, each as a proposed bead; under 600 words; no praise. No edits, no reservations, no sbt in shared checkouts. export MOTE_ACTOR=cursor-grok-4.6-help (never 'mote actor set'); post a claim line; hourly check-ins.
